reviews.text: Very happy with the lawn service which Miko has been doing for us since 2017. We Recently added bush trimming & mulching & are very pleased at the results!!!

reviews.text: I contracted with Miko Lawn & Landscaping to remove a tree and replace it with a holly bush. I have been contracting with this company for many years and am impressed with their professionalism and their pricing is very reasonable.
